scope: Separate new empty owned instance, exact pinned reference image/startup flags; no corpus/model/oracle or retry of the failed50k study

observed_configuration.filter: snapshot, storage access timeout, WAL, query/transaction timeout

rows.description: Controls whether .old dir will be used to store latest snapshot and WAL files.
rows.name: storage_backup_dir_enabled

rows.description: The number of edges and vertices stored in a batch in a snapshot file.
rows.name: storage_items_per_batch

rows.description: If true, snapshots will be created using --storage-snapshot-thread-count number of treads.
rows.name: storage_parallel_snapshot_creation

rows.description: Controls whether the storage creates another snapshot on exit.
rows.name: storage_snapshot_on_exit

rows.description: The number of snapshots that should always be kept.
rows.name: storage_snapshot_retention_count

rows.description: The number of threads used to create snapshots.
rows.name: storage_snapshot_thread_count

rows.description: Controls whether the storage uses write-ahead-logging. To enable WAL periodic snapshots must be enabled.
rows.name: storage_wal_enabled

rows.description: Issue a 'fsync' call after this amount of transactions are written to the WAL file. Set to 1 for fully synchronous operation.
rows.name: storage_wal_file_flush_every_n_tx

rows.description: Minimum file size of each WAL file.
rows.name: storage_wal_file_size_kib

rows.description: Default isolation level used for the transactions. Allowed values: SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION, READ_COMMITTED, READ_UNCOMMITTED
rows.name: isolation_level

rows.description: Maximum allowed query execution time. Queries exceeding this limit will be aborted. Value of 0 means no limit.
rows.name: query_execution_timeout_sec

rows.description: Query's storage level access timeout in seconds.
rows.name: storage_access_timeout_sec

rows.description: Define periodic snapshot schedule via cron format or as a period in seconds.
rows.name: storage_snapshot_interval

rows.description: Storage snapshot creation interval (in seconds). Set to 0 to disable periodic snapshot creation.
rows.name: storage_snapshot_interval_sec
